title: VidEarn
tagline: VidEarn: Empowering creators to own and monetize their content on Web3
description: VidEarn is a content platform designed for creators to showcase their work to users through both free and exclusive content, accessible via subscription. Users can purchase subscriptions using the custom token, and creators have the ability to offer perks and rewards to their audience. VidEarn operates on an omnichain structure using LayerZero, making it a multichain platform.
how_its_made: The VidEarn project is built using various technologies such as Solidity smart contracts, the LayerZero library for omnichain NFTs, and Lit Protocol for exclusive content. For a Web2-like login experience, we utilize Web3 Auth Kit, and Chainlink CCIP allows users to bridge to different chains based on their preferences.
